topic: Choose a birthday gift for a friend who likes practical things but already owns a lot

scenario.topic: Choose a birthday gift for a friend who likes practical things but already owns a lot
scenario.opening_question: What balance should we strike between usefulness, uniqueness, and ease of gifting?

options.name: High-quality insulated travel mug
options.upside: Useful daily for hot and cold drinks with excellent insulation
options.tradeoff: Common gift type, may feel less unique
options.concern: Friend might already own similar mugs

options.name: Compact multi-tool with screwdriver set
options.upside: Versatile and handy for various small repairs and tasks
options.tradeoff: Some tools may overlap with what friend already has
options.concern: May be bulky to carry regularly

options.name: Subscription to monthly practical gadget box
options.upside: Surprises friend with new practical items over time
options.tradeoff: Uncertainty about exact items and potential duplicates
options.concern: Subscription may include items friend already owns

options.name: Digital gift card for hardware store
options.upside: Friend chooses exactly what they need or want
options.tradeoff: Less personal, may feel like a last-minute gift

shared_context: Friend is practical and owns many typical items

personas.name: Felix
personas.background: Felix enjoys having versatile tools for small repairs and values practicality over uniqueness.
personas.private_goal: He wants a gift that offers multiple functions and can be useful in many situations, like the multi-tool.
